sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant has filed an application in I.A.No.1/2023 seeking leave of this court to withdraw the appeal and to refund the court fee.

It is stated in the affidavit that in terms of the communication dated 19.03.2021, the KNNL has taken a decision not to press this appeal, filed at the hands of the Executive Engineer, Karnataka Neeravari Nigam Limited.
In terms of the application, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
Office is directed to refund the court fee to the appellant since the matter is not heard on merits.
